reply_text:
I replied to Ilse in the thread in #north-team: "Thanks, Ilse. Noted for the team: expense reports are due this Friday, October 16."

The message was just a reminder with no request, so I didn't look anything else up. The October 16 date is my own working-out: the message is dated Wednesday, October 14, which makes Friday the 16th. I didn't set up a calendar reminder or any follow-up, because nobody asked for one.
